status: Exploratory state-spanning sample using available public proxies; no measured settlement demand or national extrapolation

selection.rule: One actual source cluster per nonmissing state, minimizing sum of squared deviations from within-state feature medians after log1p transforms and IQR scaling; tie-break by geohash. No cost-based selection.

atlas_proxy.definition: Use source total daily demand divided by potential connections, retaining source rounding; not observed consumption

recovery_1.definition: Assumed 1 kWh per potential connection per day, same hourly profile

recovery_2.definition: Assumed 2 kWh per potential connection per day, same hourly profile

grid_scope_note: Analyst scope cutoff only, not an engineering feasibility boundary. Above 50 km atlas line proximity, grid is not assessed; shared trunk expansion or regional reconstruction could change the comparison. Below cutoff, tie-in and route are still unverified.
